user.title: Bitpanda
user.description: Which service do you want to set up? Each one can be added once.

menu_options.portfolio: Bitpanda Portfolio: your holdings (needs an API key)
menu_options.price_tracker: Bitpanda Price Tracker: prices of any asset (no API key)

portfolio.title: Bitpanda Portfolio
portfolio.description: Enter your Bitpanda API key. Create one at [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}) with these permissions: Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read). Trading is not needed. Permissions cannot be added to an existing key later.

currency.title: Portfolio currency
currency.description: Bitpanda reports every value of your portfolio in this currency. You can change it later with Reconfigure, but that deletes all Portfolio sensors including their history.

price_tracker.title: Bitpanda Price Tracker
price_tracker.description: Every tracked asset always gets a price sensor in EUR. Select additional currencies to get one more sensor per asset and currency, converted with the daily reference rates of the European Central Bank. Add assets afterwards with "Add price tracker".

reauth_confirm.title: New Bitpanda API key needed
reauth_confirm.description: Bitpanda rejected the stored API key. It may have expired, or it predates the permissions this version needs. Create a new key at [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}) with Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read), and paste it here. Your sensors are kept.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Bitpanda Portfolio
reconfigure.description: To replace the stored API key, paste a new one from [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}); it needs Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read). Leave the field empty to keep the current key.

confirm_currency.title: Change the currency?
confirm_currency.description: Changing the currency from {old} to {new} deletes all Portfolio sensors including their history and recreates them in the new currency. This cannot be undone. Submit to continue, or close this dialog to keep {old}.

error.invalid_auth: Bitpanda rejected this API key. Check that it was copied completely and that it has at least one of the required permissions.
error.missing_scopes: This API key is missing permissions: {missing_scopes}. Permissions cannot be added to an existing key. Create a new one with Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read).
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Bitpanda. Try again later.

abort.all_configured: Both services are already set up.
abort.already_configured: This service is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This service is already being set up in another dialog.
abort.currency_changed: The currency was changed. The Portfolio sensors are being recreated.
abort.no_reconfigure: The Price Tracker has nothing to reconfigure. Use Configure to choose its currencies.

init.title: Price Tracker currencies
init.description: Every tracked asset always keeps its EUR sensor. Each selected currency adds one sensor per asset; removing a currency deletes those sensors.

user.title: Add price tracker
user.description: Which kind of asset do you want to track?

asset.title: Add price tracker
asset.description: Type to search by name, symbol or ISIN, then pick one asset. Submit without a choice to go back to the asset types.

error.no_assets_available: Every asset of this type is already tracked.
error.unknown_asset: Pick an asset from the list.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Bitpanda. Try again later.
